rules.title: Judge brand and non-brand separately
rules.how: Campaigns named as brand, or containing the brand names you enter, are separated out. Non-brand campaigns are judged against the non-brand average, not the account average.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Apply brand exclusions to Performance Max or Search campaigns
Google Ads Help: Answering your top questions about Performance Max

rules.title: Feed efficient campaigns that are losing impressions to budget
rules.how: A non-brand campaign beating the non-brand average while losing more than 10% of impression share to budget is flagged as held back.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Get impression share data (Search lost IS (budget))
Microsoft Advertising Help: Share of voice and impression share columns

rules.title: Losing impressions to rank means ad quality or bids
rules.how: Campaigns losing more than 30% of impression share to rank are flagged. Google's guidance is to improve ad quality and bids.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Search campaign performance fluctuations: lost impression share

rules.title: Question spend with no recorded conversions
rules.how: Campaigns with spend and no conversions in the period are flagged. If they have an upper-funnel job, they need a measure that proves it.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Tips on measuring Smart Bidding performance

rules.title: Low conversion volume limits what automation can learn
rules.how: Campaigns with fewer than 15 conversions in the period are marked as low data, so their results are read with caution.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About Smart Bidding learning
Google Ads Help: bid strategy conversion requirements

rules.title: Open up Performance Max with its channel and search term reports
rules.how: When Performance Max takes more than 40% of spend, the X-ray suggests checking where it serves and what it matches to.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About the channel performance report for Performance Max
Google Ads Help: About the search terms report in Performance Max

rules.title: Use the search terms report to find negative keywords
rules.how: Search terms that spent money without converting are listed, along with words that only ever appear in non-converting searches.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Get negative keyword ideas using the search terms report
Microsoft Advertising Help: About search terms

rules.title: Know your exposure to AI Mode
rules.how: Spend through broad match, AI Max and Performance Max is eligible for contextual matching in AI Overviews and AI Mode. Exact and phrase match only serve there on directly commercial queries.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About ads in AI Overviews and AI Mode

rules.title: Manual bidding with enough data is worth testing against Smart Bidding
rules.how: If the file includes bid strategy and a meaningful share of spend is on manual CPC in campaigns with enough conversions, the X-ray suggests a controlled test.

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Tips on measuring Smart Bidding performance
